classes: C0 controls but tab and line feed
Unicode's Cf but the zero-width non-joiner and joiner
description: The visible form of a text from data (SPEC D312, D428), written by aibi.core.schema.export from aibi.core.schema.visible: the server's page and the web bundle escape the same code points. Do not edit; regenerate under the pinned Python.

raw_by_d312.note: Code points D312 leaves raw although a renderer may draw them as nothing or alike (D428, O-2: recorded for the owner, not changed): the default-ignorable code points that are neither Cf nor a control (variation selectors, the combining grapheme joiner, the Hangul fillers) and the unassigned ones, the space separators but U+0020, and U+2800. The tag characters U+E0001 and U+E0020..U+E007F are Cf, so a subdivision flag's tag sequence is escaped.

rules.cut: a text from data is cut at `cut` code points (never splitting a surrogate pair), before it is folded or escaped, and the cut is marked; pointers, statistic references and data tokens are not cut
rules.escape: each unsafe code point is written \xNN below U+0100, \uNNNN below U+10000, \UNNNNNNNN above, in lower-case hex, one per code point (a lone surrogate is one)
rules.fold: a carriage return immediately before a line feed is dropped (after the cut)
rules.listed: a list from data (domain tags, facet values) shows its first `listed` members, then how many more it holds
rules.runs: each maximal run of unsafe code points is one escaped run (one span)
